purpose: The user asks for the cover letter in German while the ad is in English (a German-speaking employer). The first reply asks for the CV only, so the German wish can come with the request for the letter; if the app writes the letter anyway, the wish is sent as a change request once the letter exists, so it reaches the app either way.
correct_behaviour: The cover letter is written in correct, natural German; the CV stays in the language of the ad; the letter's facts are the same as in English would be.
first: Please write my CV first. Once it is done, I will tell you what I need for the cover letter.
cover_letter: Thank you. Now please write the cover letter in German - the hiring manager prefers German.

requests.text: Thank you. Please rewrite the cover letter in German - the hiring manager prefers German. The CV stays as it is.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final cover letter is entirely in German, fluent and professional; the CV is not translated.

expectations.correct_behaviour: The final cover letter is entirely in German, fluent and professional; the CV is not translated.
